information:
The first WCA competition in Shenzhen took place ten years ago, and cubing community has developed a lot in the past decade.
Now we are holding the **10th** WCA competition in this city, celebrating the **10th** anniversary of Shenzhen cubing.
10 x 10 = 100. Please come and join us to get 100% fun and joy!
